research_statement.topic: Multi-device diary study for mobile researchers
research_statement.objective: Identify friction in week-long diary submissions
research_statement.scope: North American research teams running diary studies

key_questions.question: What causes participants to abandon diary entries?
key_questions.answer: Notification fatigue and fragmented prompts cause 61% of drop-offs.

key_questions.question: Which retention tactics keep compliance high?
key_questions.answer: Auto-summaries + weekend catch-up blocks maintain 94% completion.

key_insights: Bundled evening prompts outperform hourly pings for mobile-heavy participants.
Moderators who provide AI-generated summaries reduce participant confusion.
Weekend catch-up windows rescue 22% of near-missed entries.
surprising_findings: Participants prefer Slack reminders over SMS for multi-device diaries.

evidence.summary: Notification fatigue causes 61% of diary drop-offs across six studies.
Weekend catch-up windows rescue 22% of near-missed diary entries.
AI-generated diary recaps keep completion at 94% when paired with bundled prompts.
